reel.caption:
Switched jobs this year? Could you owe tax at filing?

Each employer works out your TDS as if its salary is your only income, so both can apply the ₹75,000 standard deduction and the ₹12 lakh rebate.
Illustrative: ₹7 lakh at each job → ₹0 TDS at both. Combined ₹14 lakh (standard deduction once) → ₹13.25 lakh taxable → ≈ ₹81,900 tax in the new regime, including cess.
Fix: give your new employer your earlier salary and TDS details, and pay any gap early as self-assessment tax to keep interest down.

Did your new HR ask for your old salary details?

Sources: a financial-planning firm's job-switch tax guide (July 2026) with this example, a personal-finance magazine (July 2026), and two FY 2026-27 slab summaries; we re-checked the arithmetic.
